name: solidity-bug-patterns
skills: Solidity vulnerability patterns, class by class: reentrancy in all variants, denial of service and griefing, input validation and arithmetic, unsafe casts, external call safety and weird ERC-20 tokens, state invariants, guard consistency, oracles and flash loans, signature replay, proxies. Shows the vulnerable pattern beside the safe one. Knowledge: QuillShield's open security skills (MIT).
examples: Does this contract have reentrancy, in any variant?
Can someone block withdrawals or make this function run out of gas?
Which overflows and unsafe casts does this Solidity 0.7 code have?
